crew.overview: Germany, 1944. Leyna, the 15-year old daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets Lutz, a compassionate member of the Hitler Youth whose father is a prominent Nazi soldier, and they form an unlikely connection in this quickly changing world.
crew.title: Where Hands Touch

details.biography: Ivan Dunleavy is a Producer and former CEO of Pinewood Group for 17 years before departing in 2017 following a buyout. He now owns Tara Studios with business partner John Gleesan, based at the 154-acre Borleagh Manor estate in County Wexford less than an hour’s drive from Dublin
details.name: Ivan Dunleavy
